test_replace_explicit_none: test replacing empty strings with None in a pandas Series while preserving dtype
test_replace_noop_doesnt_downcast: test that replacing np.nan with None on an object dtype Series does not downcast
test_replace_list_single_value: test replacing multiple values with a single scalar value in a pandas Series
test_replace_dict_mapping: test replacing values using a dictionary mapping to_replace to replacement in a pandas Series
test_replace_parallel_lists: test replacing values using parallel lists of to_replace and replacement values in a pandas Series
test_replace_inplace: test performing in-place replacement on a pandas Series and verifying the returned reference
test_replace_nan_with_inf: test replacing np.nan and np.inf values in a pandas Series
test_replace_datetime64: test replacing Timestamp values in a datetime64 pandas Series
test_replace_timedelta: test replacing timedelta values in a timedelta64 pandas Series
test_replace_categorical: test replacing values in a categorical pandas Series and verifying category handling
test_replace_nullable_numeric: test replacing values in nullable numeric dtypes like Int64 and Float64
test_replace_string_dtype: test replacing values in a nullable string dtype pandas Series
test_replace_regex: test replacing values in a pandas Series using compiled regex patterns
test_replace_bool_no_cast: test that replacing an integer with a boolean preserves the boolean type
test_replace_cascade: test that replaced values are not replaced again in a single replace call
